mapper.select: SELECT MIN(scope_id) scopeId, credential_id credentialId, MIN(scope_code) scopeCode, MIN(version) version FROM t_api_credential_scope WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND effective_from<=#{effectiveAt} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>#{effectiveAt}) GROUP BY credential_id, BINARY scope_code ORDER BY scopeCode LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.scope_id scopeId,g.scope_code scopeCode,s.display_name displayName,g.resource_pattern resourcePattern, g.action_code actionCode,g.status storedStatus,g.effective_from effectiveFrom,g.effective_to effectiveTo, g.version,g.create_time createTime,g.update_time updateTime FROM t_api_credential_scope g LEFT JOIN t_api_scope s ON s.scope_code=g.scope_code AND BINARY s.scope_code=BINARY g.scope_code WHERE g.credential_id=#{id} ORDER BY g.scope_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_api_credential_scope WHERE credential_id=#{id}
